derivation: or מַדֻּעַ; from H4100 (מָה) and the passive participle of H3045 (יָדַע);

occurrences.text: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
